notes.title: Developer Update: Known Issues
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We want to inform you about some known issues in our game. We're aware of these problems and are working hard to resolve them:
[list]
[*] 
[*] Settings Menu: Cursor issues when trying to click on options.
[*] Localization Errors: Incorrect or missing translations in some texts.
[*] FPS Mode: Unable to jump off stairs in first-person mode.
[*] Items: An item disappearing after being read once in a specific section.
[*] Ghost Rendering: The ghost not rendering properly under certain conditions in a scene.
[*] ESC Key: Cursor disappearing when pressing ESC during an inspection.
[*] SFX Settings: Unable to turn SFX back on after turning it off.
[*] We’re actively working on these issues and plan to release updates to fix them as soon as possible.
[/list]

Temporary Workarounds:
While we prepare the updates, you can try the following to avoid some of these issues:

[list]
[*] If the cursor disappears, press ESC again to bring it back.
[*] In the settings menu, use the arrow button on the far left of the options menu to navigate.
[*] Switch to TPS mode to jump off stairs.
[/list]

If you encounter any additional bugs or want to report an issue, feel free to email us at [url=]support@kairadigitalarts.com][b]support@kairadigitalarts.com[/b][/url].

Thank you for your patience and support!

Kaira Digital Arts Team
